description.value: A mega-analysis of structural MRI data pooled from 23 laboratories in 14 countries to identify general and substance-specific associations between substance dependence and regional brain volume or cortical thickness.

spans.text: The objective was to identify general and substance-specific associations between dependence and regional brain volumes.

description.value: Multisite observational mega-analysis of previously published structural MRI data pooled from 23 laboratories, with substance-dependent and nondependent control groups and cross-validated analyses.

spans.text: This first project of the Addiction Working Group has pooled data from 23 laboratories in 14 countries
